paragraphs.text: When commercial exteriors start showing algae, mildew, and environmental buildup, property managers have two competing priorities: get the building looking clean again—and avoid damaging finishes in the process. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial exterior soft washing as a low-pressure cleaning option designed to safely remove organic growth and grime from appropriate exterior surfaces. We serve commercial properties only, with a specialty in commercial multi-family communities.

Soft washing is a low-pressure method that uses professionally applied cleaning solutions to break down organic growth and surface contaminants, followed by a controlled rinse. This approach is often preferred when surfaces are sensitive or when higher pressure could cause unwanted effects.

Scope depends on your building materials and access, but commercial soft washing is commonly used on building façades where organic growth is visible, exterior common-area surfaces exposed to shade and moisture, and garage exteriors and other large exterior surfaces that collect buildup over time.

paragraphs.text: Commercial multi-family properties depend on dryer exhaust systems that move air efficiently and safely. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial dryer vent cleaning for property managers who want a structured approach, clear coordination, and a scope that matches how the building is actually vented. Methods include exterior access cleaning (compressed air and hose-based equipment through exterior termination), interior access cleaning (high-pressure air sweeps and negative-air capture from within individual units), and central duct/shared shaft cleaning for buildings with centrally vented systems.

paragraphs.text: Bathrooms generate moisture—and exhaust systems are the first line of defense for moving that moisture out of the building. When bathroom exhaust fans and ductwork become clogged or underperform, humidity can linger, odors can persist, and moisture issues can escalate. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial bathroom exhaust cleaning to restore airflow, support moisture management, and keep exhaust systems functioning the way they're intended. We work with commercial properties only, including commercial multi-family communities.

Scope varies by building design, but a typical cleaning project focuses on the fan assembly and associated ductwork where debris buildup restricts airflow. Our goal is to remove accumulated dust and buildup that can impair performance over time.

Exhaust issues often show up first as complaints: lingering humidity, odors, or bathrooms that never feel like they "dry out." A planned cleaning program helps property teams reduce reactive calls and supports a more consistent resident/tenant experience.

paragraphs.text: When exhaust systems fail, cleaning alone may not solve the problem. If a bathroom exhaust fan is not operating reliably, or airflow remains poor even after buildup is addressed, repair becomes a maintenance priority. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial bathroom exhaust repair to help property managers restore functional ventilation, reduce recurring complaints, and support moisture control.

Common indicators include fans that are noisy or intermittent, bathrooms that stay damp for long periods, persistent odors, or weak airflow at grilles. In multi-unit environments, a single failing component can indicate a broader pattern across the building, so it is important to evaluate consistently.

Repair work may involve restoring secure connections, addressing fan performance issues, or replacing components that are no longer working as intended, depending on what is accessible and approved. We coordinate access planning with property managers and maintenance teams to reduce disruption.

paragraphs.text: Clogged gutters and downspouts can create outsized problems on commercial properties: overflow, staining, ice-related concerns, and water where you don't want it. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial gutter cleaning for property managers who want a consistent, documented approach to roof-edge drainage maintenance. We work with commercial properties only, including commercial multi-family communities.

Our gutter service focuses on clearing debris and obstructions from gutters and downspouts so water can drain properly. We also look for obvious issues that affect performance—visible damage, sections that appear unsafe to service, or drainage limitations that should be addressed by a repair scope.

Gutter cleaning isn't just a seasonal "nice to have." It supports drainage performance during heavy rain and reduces the likelihood of overflow conditions that can stain exteriors or create slip hazards near entries and walkways.

paragraphs.text: HVAC systems move air through buildings every day. When dust and debris accumulate in ductwork or HVAC components, it can contribute to performance issues and complicate indoor air quality management—especially on multi-unit commercial properties. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial HVAC cleaning for property managers who want a responsibly scoped service focused on airflow support, cleanliness, and practical coordination. We work with commercial properties only.

Because HVAC systems vary significantly by building and design, our scopes are built around what's accessible, what's needed, and what supports your maintenance goals. We use equipment and methods that support containment and capture, rather than simply moving debris from one place to another.
HVAC cleaning should be defensible and properly scoped. The right approach starts with assessment and continues with a cleaning plan that targets the areas that matter.

image.alt: HVAC system cleaning and maintenance service

paragraphs.text: Indoor air questions can turn into operational headaches fast—especially when you manage multiple buildings, multiple stakeholders, and limited time to troubleshoot. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial air quality testing to help property managers and facility teams move from "we think something's wrong" to actionable data. We work with commercial properties only.

Air quality testing is most valuable when it supports a decision: confirming baseline conditions, investigating a complaint pattern, documenting conditions around a maintenance event, or prioritizing next steps for ventilation and cleaning.

Air quality testing is commonly requested after persistent odor or comfort complaints, dust concerns that don't resolve with normal cleaning, moisture events or suspected ventilation underperformance, or for "before/after" documentation for maintenance and cleaning projects.

paragraphs.text: Small gaps can cause big problems on commercial properties. When exterior caulking fails at joints and transitions, water intrusion and air leakage become more likely—and the longer it's left unaddressed, the more expensive the downstream consequences can be. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial caulking services for property managers who want practical, well-coordinated exterior maintenance. We work with commercial properties only.

Caulking targets exterior joints, seams, and penetrations where sealant has cracked, separated, or deteriorated over time. A properly scoped caulking project helps reduce unwanted air movement and helps limit pathways for water intrusion at common weak points in the building envelope.
Commercial caulking is not just "apply more sealant." Results depend on correct surface preparation, selecting the right material for the condition, and installing it correctly.

image.alt: Commercial caulking and sealing services

paragraphs.text: Commercial buildings expand, contract, and weather year after year. Over time, exterior joints and penetrations can open up, sealants can fail, and small pathways can allow air and water to move where they shouldn't. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial sealing services to help property managers protect building exteriors, reduce preventable water intrusion, and support more consistent building performance. We work with commercial properties only.

Commercial sealing services focus on exterior envelope details—especially joints, seams, and penetrations that become vulnerable over time. While caulking is one common sealing method, sealing services are often scoped more broadly to fit the building's conditions.

Property teams often call us when they see recurring signs such as localized staining, minor water intrusion indicators, drafts, or visibly deteriorated sealant conditions around penetrations and transitions. Addressing these issues early can reduce the chance that a small envelope weakness becomes a bigger repair project later.

Soft washing projects are staged to reduce disruption. We coordinate with property management on water availability, occupant notifications (as needed), and protection of sensitive areas. paragraphs.text: Commercial multi-family properties depend on dryer exhaust systems that move air efficiently and safely. When lint and debris accumulate inside dryer exhaust ducts, airflow can drop, equipment can work harder, and risk can increase. Air Tech Solutions provides commercial dryer vent cleaning for property managers who want a structured approach, clear coordination, and a scope that matches how the building is actually vented. Methods of cleaning (matched to your building design)
Dryer exhaust systems vary widely from property to property—so we align the method to the layout:

Exterior access cleaning
When ducts are accessible from the building exterior, we can clean from the outside using compressed air and hose-based equipment inserted through the exterior termination. This approach dislodges lint and debris from interior duct surfaces and conveys material through the system—often without requiring unit-by-unit interior access.

Interior access cleaning
When interior access is required or preferred, dryer exhaust ducts can be cleaned from within individual units using high-pressure air sweeps and negative-air capture. This method is intended to clean the full length of the exhaust pathway (from the dryer connection point toward the exterior termination) while capturing lint and particulate buildup. During service, the dryer-to-exhaust connection can be visually checked for obvious issues such as loose attachment or visible leakage.

Central duct / shared shaft cleaning
Some buildings use shared or centrally vented dryer systems (often terminating at roof ducts/shafts). In these cases, central ducts can be cleaned as part of the scope. Technicians may access the central duct by removing the exhaust fan assembly as needed, then use compressed-air agitation combined with high-powered vacuum capture to remove accumulated lint and debris. Once cleaning is complete, the fan assembly is reinstalled and secured.

Resident/tenant coordination (when interior access is needed)
For interior-access projects, coordination is everything. Air Tech Solutions can support scheduling workflows in coordination with property management, including resident/tenant communications and appointment scheduling when authorized. Unit access requirements and any per-unit billing/collection process (if applicable) are handled according to the property’s rules and the approved proposal—no pricing is published or assumed without authorization.

If a unit/system cannot be accessed or safely serviced at the scheduled time, it is documented and excluded. Repairs, modifications, or code corrections are not performed unless separately authorized in writing.
